- [PREFERENCE] User asked if any of the themes can help with reducing eye strain during prolonged use.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirmed that some themes can help reduce eye strain, specifically mentioning:
  - Material Dark theme has a dark color scheme that reduces bright light.
  - Simplify Dark theme has a muted color palette that is easier on the eyes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised that it's a good idea to take frequent breaks and adjust screen brightness to reduce eye strain, in addition to using the themes.
